scope: One trained recipe, new question wording and actual generated chat history. Assistant source inspection; not expert brewing review or general accuracy.
pass_rule: Read the complete answer. All requested facts and relationships must be correct, with adequate completeness and plain language. No invented recipe settings, contradictions, false claims that provided facts are missing, or looping/truncation. Lexical matches and low loss cannot pass a case.
complete_guide: Source batch 7 gallons / 26.5 L; never silently substitute five gallons.

All eight source ingredient entries: 9.5 lb / 4.31 kg Pilsner; 1 lb / 0.45 kg torrified wheat; 5 oz / 142 g melanoidin; 7 oz / 198 g acidulated malt; one Whirlfloc tablet; 1.9 oz / 54 g Tettnanger at 4% AA; listed Wyeast 2247 with 4 L starter and source White Labs alternatives; medium carbonate water. Do not invent a water volume or alternative yeast dose.
130°F / 54°C for 10 minutes, then 148°F / 64°C for 60 minutes; mash-out 168°F / 76°C; fly sparge 170°F / 77°C.
90-minute total boil. Hops with 60 minutes remaining (30 elapsed), Whirlfloc with 10 remaining (80 elapsed). No invented dry hop or other additions.
Cool promptly, clean/sanitize cooled-wort equipment, pitch listed yeast. No invented separate exact pitching temperature.
Primary 50°F / 10°C for two to three weeks, then keg and gelatin clarification, then later lagering 40°F / 4°C for three to six weeks. Preserve order and distinguish the two temperature stages.
Genuine source gaps: water amounts/profile, separate pitching conditions, gelatin dose and carbonation/bottling details. Do not deny the stated fermentation/lagering temperatures or durations.

Explain unfamiliar actions simply. Label repeated stable gravity readings as a general completion check, not a recipe-specific numeric gravity target. Calendar and quiet airlock alone do not prove completion.
followups: Answer the requested part directly with the same source facts. Correct a mistaken premise, acknowledge actual omissions, and preserve stage relationships. A complete recipe dump in place of a short follow-up does not demonstrate conversational scope control.
success_gate: All five development cases, all four consumed original-final regression cases, all four freshly frozen confirmation cases and all four original actual-history dialogue turns must pass full-answer review as one model. The original final was consumed by the rejected status adapter and is no longer untouched. Confirmation/dialogue generation follows development selection. No factual acceptance criterion is relaxed. Success does not establish competence on another recipe. The natural dialogue adds two beginner-explanation turns; both must also pass factual and plain-language inspection. Two direct development explanation cases also check the same general concepts under different wording before selection; these do not replace the reserved conversational questions. After the first natural dialogue omits gelatin in a combined water-and-gelatin request, its six turns and the first four confirmation questions become consumed regression evidence. A continuation must retain all fifteen non-conversational cases and all six original natural-dialogue turns, then pass a second four-question confirmation set and a freshly worded six-turn conversation frozen before training. The final paired before/after comparison uses those ten fresh cases. No factual requirement is relaxed. The fresh-base attention-only run retains these regression requirements. One additional ingredient-only question is frozen before training, increasing final confirmation to five single-turn questions plus six actual-history turns. The original neutral system prompt is used; rejected format cues are not adopted.
